summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (Task.finished_time field, finished property derived from it, _reset clears it, TimeElapsedColumn class, capture in update and advance, clear in reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with in-method imports and TYPE_CHECKING table import); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entries); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast); tests/test_progress.py (test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns, and test_columns expected output regenerated by hand trace). Verification was by reading and by grep counts of the bar-width runs (25 x8, 16 x4, no 33 or 23 left); the tests were not run, so test_columns is unverified until pytest is run. Docs were not updated, since the spec did not include them.
